subject: general
concept: Art and Architecture, Art and Culture
question: Which is the state that leads in the list of monuments of national importance in South India declared by Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ Karnataka__.**

__
 
• **Karnataka is the state that leads in the list of monuments of national importance in South India declared by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).**__
 
• With** 506 monuments**, **Karnataka** leads **South India in the ASI list.**
 
• There were** 3,686** centrally protected monuments/sites under the ASI in the country; the number has now increased to **3,693**. 
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh **(745 monuments/sites)**
 
• Karnataka **(506),** 
 
• and Tamil Nadu** (413**) has the highest number of **ASI-maintained sites.**​
